answer: Compare every answer's meaning, not just its wording. Each epoch, embed all submissions and flag any pair of keys whose answers sit above 0.92 similarity three epochs running. Flagged keys share one payout seat, and their pay waits in a 20-epoch exit queue before it can move. A farm of 200 keys fed by one model reads like violet ink from one pen: it cannot reach the summit of the reward table, and its queued pay melts back to honest ivory-tower graders who catch it.
